in_marathi.name: Rajani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ratn' (Jewel) and 'Rani' (Queen), Rajani means 'Queen of the night' or 'Night of jewels'. It is an exquisite and majestic name, evoking images of the moon and its queen, Chandra.
